# Contract: perspective-illusion

Foundation skill from [simcraft](https://github.com/dotslashsimran/simcraft) at `58224d1` (MIT, Simran Sachdeva), modified by SumitCraft. Category: video. Kind: scripted.

## Purpose
Looping illustrated 3D scenes that read as flat drawings on a telephoto lens and open into depth through dolly zooms and corner views.

## Use it for
- "make a perspective-illusion loop of a rainy street"
- "dolly-zoom flat-to-3D illustrated scene"

## Not for
- a seamless shader loop with no scene (code-loop)
- copy this artist's video exactly (refused: technique only)

## Accepted inputs
A place to depict, optional reference frames, loop length.

## Deliverables
scene.html, stills, preview.mp4, final.mp4, motion and blink check output.

## Prerequisites
Required:
- Node.js 18.19+
- Playwright npm package (npm install)
- Playwright Chromium binary (npx playwright install chromium, ~150-200 MB)
- three@0.170.0 in the work folder
- ffmpeg (on PATH or FFMPEG)

Optional:
- Python 3.9+
- NumPy

Check them with `node tools/doctor.mjs` (Windows: `tools\doctor.ps1`).

## Local and network behaviour
npm install of three and playwright in the work folder; rendering is local.

## Cost-sensitive operations
Full-quality finals are slow (upstream measured about 30 min for 10 s on Apple Silicon); always stills and preview first.

## Workflow
1. Build a scene that can fool the eye
2. Choreograph the camera
3. The look
4. Detail passes (what makes it great)
5. Render and check

Full steps: [SKILL.md](SKILL.md).

## Human decisions
- Scene and palette (offer options; no house style)
- Approve the preview before the final render

## Quality checks
- Stills at every key time against the quality bar
- motion_check.py: nothing freezes
- blink_map.py count compared before/after a change
- a person watches the loop

## Common failures
- Surfaces a few cm apart flicker at 400 m
- Screen-space hatching crawls
- Missing cut-out PNGs in scramble_night (not shipped)

## Limitations
- Heavy templates; software WebGL is very slow
- Template cut-outs are not distributed (provenance)

## Reproducible example
templates/street.html rendered as low-scale stills (see evidence/perspective-illusion).
